description: CaNa₂(SO₄)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.72 Å. Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.63 Å. S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.47 Å) and two longer (1.48 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one S atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂CaS tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ca, and one S atom.
